## Competitive position (process wall, ms; independent bootstrap, median ÷ median)

Zeebra figures are this cohort's final binary: `en` the opt-in path, `f4` shipping. grobx and groebner-rs run one worker on the wide rows (their wide adapters refuse more), so a 16-worker Zeebra row against them is a **best-supported-configuration** row, and the equal-worker row is beside it. msolve and groebner-rs on MQ10 are their fastest median of 1/4/8/16 workers in the window. grobx raw is randomized and uncertified; grobx certified, groebner-rs (verified), msolve exact and Zeebra (deterministic, certified) are separate rows, never merged.
